title: Creamy Lemon Pepper Chickpea Skillet
description: This 20-minute lemon pepper chickpea skillet dinner is about to earn a spot in your dinner rotation! Creamy, zesty, and full of flavor.

vegetarian.notes: Swap the Parmesan for a vegetarian-certified Parmesan (look for 'vegetarian rennet' on the label) — same quantity, stir in at the same step. Everything else is already vegetarian.

steps.text: Melt {i01} in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add {i02}, {i03}, {i04}, and {i05}. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, or until garlic is fragrant.

steps.text: Stir in {i06} until combined, then slowly drizzle in {i07}. Bring to a gentle simmer until sauce thickens. Stir in {i08} (drained), cover, and let simmer for about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Finish and Garnish
steps.text: Remove pan from the heat then stir in {i09}, {i10}, and {i11}. Garnish with {i12} and {i13}. (Sauce will continue to thicken as it cools.)
